tasks.title: Special-case epic plans in _check_hallucination so sub-epic plan-kickoffs are not discarded (NGv2 Epic-3)
acceptance_criteria: harness/autowork_daemon.py::_check_hallucination gains an epic-plan special-case BEFORE the existing `tasks` check and AFTER the `wall < min_wall` guard: when plan_dict.get('plan_kind') == 'epic', a non-empty list child_slugs returns (False, '') and an empty/missing child_slugs returns (True, 'empty_epic').
The `wall < float(min_wall)` guard stays ABOVE the new epic branch (a sub-min-wall epic kickoff still returns (True, 'wall<min')).

The existing leaf-plan logic is reproduced byte-identically: a leaf plan with no tasks list still returns (True, 'empty_plan'); the all_gemini/any_reconciled loop returning (True, 'all_gemini_no_reconciled') or (False, '') is unchanged.

spec.objective: Close the NGv2 Epic-3 daemon-driven epic-kickoff blocker. _check_hallucination treats any plan with no `tasks` list as an empty_plan hallucination, but an EPIC plan legitimately carries no tasks (only child_slugs + child_briefs). So every daemon plan-kickoff of a sub-epic is mis-flagged empty_plan, the epic plan is unlinked, a .failed backoff marker is written, and no sub-epic plan ever persists -> the whole multi-level run stalls at 0 builds. Fix: special-case plan_kind=='epic' in _check_hallucination so a non-empty child_slugs decomposition is valid, while a genuinely empty epic decomposition is still flagged.
functional_requirements: In _check_hallucination, after the existing `if wall < float(min_wall): return (True, 'wall<min')` guard and BEFORE reading `tasks`, add: if isinstance(plan_dict, dict) and plan_dict.get('plan_kind') == 'epic': read child_slugs = plan_dict.get('child_slugs'); if isinstance(child_slugs, list) and child_slugs: return (False, ''); else return (True, 'empty_epic').

Make NO other change to _check_hallucination. The wall guard, the `tasks` extraction, the empty-tasks `empty_plan` return, and the all_gemini/any_reconciled loop and its `all_gemini_no_reconciled`/`(False,'')` returns are reproduced byte-for-byte.
Preserve the function signature `_check_hallucination(plan_dict: dict, wall_seconds: float, min_wall: float=10.0) -> tuple[bool, str]` and the wall_seconds float-coercion try/except exactly.
spec.interfaces: harness/autowork_daemon._check_hallucination(plan_dict: dict, wall_seconds: float, min_wall: float=10.0) -> tuple[bool, str]. Signature and return contract UNCHANGED. The new epic branch returns (False, '') for a non-empty child_slugs epic plan and (True, 'empty_epic') for an empty/missing one; leaf-plan behavior is identical to before.
edge_cases: Epic plan with wall<min_wall -> still (True, 'wall<min') (wall guard is above the epic branch).

Leaf plan {'tasks':[...]} well-attributed -> (False, '') unchanged; leaf plan {'tasks':[]} -> (True, 'empty_plan') unchanged; all-gemini-no-reconciled leaf -> (True, 'all_gemini_no_reconciled') unchanged.
non_goals: Do NOT change the wall<min_wall guard, the empty_plan path for leaf plans, or the all_gemini_no_reconciled logic.
Do NOT touch _auto_promote, the discard/unlink path, or any other function in autowork_daemon.py.
Do not add imports or use eval/exec/__import__.

integration: single-function contract pinned by the committed oracle tests/adversarial/test_epic_hallucination_guard.py plus the existing tests/adversarial/test_autowork_auto_promote.py regression suite; no broader wiring.
